relations.description: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain Emergency number list IE
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain Extended emergency number list IE
Extended emergency number list IE contains EENLV field
EENLV field guards by country validity condition
EENLV field guards by PLMN-only validity condition
PLMN-only validity condition establishes UE storage of emergency lists
Different country condition establishes deletion of stored emergency lists
Registration procedure includes receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
